# Drift anatomy (generated by `uv run python run.py`)

Evals harness commit 190ed339f41924ae0244e0b88c5ebe647ddd9eb4 (branch t3/evals). Walks: MARViN bar and church, 25 walks, all within 10% of the reference's scale; atrium is left out because its reference jitters by up to 0.4 m. ADVIO 20 to 22, 3 walks, against the ground truth rescaled to GPS. Heading offset: the per-sample offset at each loop's or window's start, as the evals use it.

## A1, return to the meter

Loops: reference points more than 30 s apart and under 0.3 m apart (3-D). Starts within 5 s of each other form one cluster, and each cluster keeps its closest pair. r is the horizontal error of ARKit's displacement at the return; the peak is the largest such error at the samples between.

Loops: 56 (MARViN 56, ADVIO 0). Closest revisit per ADVIO walk, within the span where ARKit tracks: advio-20 1.59 m, advio-21 0.76 m, advio-22 2.13 m. On 20 and 21 the truth comes back closer to where it was in its first 2 s, but ARKit only starts tracking about 4 s in.

Peak within max(2r, 2 in): 30 of 56 (54%). Criterion: at least 90% of at least 8 loops. **FAIL.**

Not graded: median r 13.2 in. Peak / r: median 1.9, p90 6.1. Peak / (0.16 x largest excursion): median 0.15, p90 0.42; within the allowance in 100% of loops. Checks not in the pre-registration: one loop per walk (its closest pair), 20 loops, 60% within the bound; one heading offset per walk (its circular mean) instead of the sample at t0, 54% within the bound.

Added after the run: a scale or heading error grows with distance from the start and cancels on return, so r cannot see it. With each walk's own scale divided out of ARKit, 75% of loops fall within the bound.

## A2, scale within a walk

Local scale: ARKit's straight-line displacement over the reference's, on windows of 5 m and 10 m of reference path starting every 1 m. Windows whose reference chord is under 60% of their path (the walker turned back) are left out. Spread is within-walk: SD about each walk's mean, and 1.4826 x MAD about each walk's median, pooled over walks. The split fits SD(L)^2 = persistent^2 + (c/L)^2 to the 5 m and 10 m spreads. The part falling as 1/L is endpoint noise from either track, the reference's jitter included.

| Data | 5 m windows (turning, left out) | SD 5 m | Robust SD 5 m | SD 10 m | Robust SD 10 m | 1/L part at 5 m (SD / robust) | Persistent part (SD / robust) | Criterion |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| MARViN | 3782 (249) | 5.70% | 1.83% | 4.50% | 1.33% | 4.04% / 1.45% | 4.02% / 1.11% | over 3%: drop |
| ADVIO | 1267 (0) | 19.36% | 10.91% | 17.09% | 9.55% | 10.50% / 6.10% | 16.26% / 9.05% | over 3%: drop |

Added after the run: on MARViN the SD is three times the robust SD because of a few windows where ARKit barely moves while the reference walks on, the disagreement that put three atrium walks in doubt in the evals. Share of 5 m windows more than 10% from their walk's median: MARViN 2.7%; ADVIO 39.7%. ADVIO's spread is broad, not a tail. Its truth is an inertial track pinned at fix points, so its own scale can wander between pins, and that does not fall as 1/L either.

Per walk, 5 m windows (median local scale, SD, robust SD). MARViN's median is against a reference whose own scale is unverified; ADVIO's is against GPS.

## A3, along and across travel

The evals' windows: from every image (MARViN) or every 0.5 s (ADVIO) until the reference has covered exactly the distance. The horizontal error splits into the part along the reference's horizontal displacement and the part across it. p90 of |error|, inches.

| MARViN | 10 ft | 5047 | 5.9 | 2.4 | 6.4 | 0.93 | 2.0 | 6.8 |
| MARViN | 20 ft | 4956 | 9.6 | 3.8 | 10.4 | 0.92 | 3.0 | 10.9 |
| MARViN | 30 ft | 4866 | 12.5 | 5.5 | 13.6 | 0.92 | 3.6 | 14.1 |

| ADVIO | 30 ft | 1889 | 97.4 | 110.4 | 132.5 | 0.73 | 9.2 | 132.6 |

Criterion at 20 ft: along p90 at most 0.60 of the horizontal total p90. MARViN 0.92, FAIL; ADVIO 0.76, FAIL.

Added after review: a wall plane removes the error along the wall's normal, and that is the across-travel axis only while the walk runs straight along the wall. In windows that turn, across holds some along-wall error and along holds some error a plane would remove, so the graded split above cannot by itself say whether a plane helps. The walks have no wall annotations, so the windows below stand in for a walk along a wall: those whose reference path stays within the given distance of its own start-to-end line. The widths are untuned and not pre-registered.

## A4, a range to the meter

Each window is a session that starts at the meter, where the second phone stays. A simulated range from each window's start to its end: the reference's 3-D distance plus N(0, sigma), 20 draws per window (seed 0). ARKit's end moves radially in the horizontal plane about the start, keeping its height, onto the range. p90 horizontal error, inches. sigma 0.10 m is graded; 0.05 and 0.20 m are not.

| Data | Walked | Before | After, 0.05 m | After, 0.10 m | After, 0.20 m |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| MARViN | 10 ft | 6.4 | 4.1 | 7.1 | 13.5 |
| MARViN | 20 ft | 10.4 | 4.9 | 7.7 | 14.0 |
| MARViN | 30 ft | 13.6 | 6.1 | 8.5 | 14.7 |
| ADVIO | 10 ft | 55.6 | 40.1 | 40.4 | 41.0 |
| ADVIO | 20 ft | 94.3 | 77.2 | 77.3 | 77.6 |
| ADVIO | 30 ft | 132.5 | 112.5 | 112.5 | 112.7 |

Criterion: p90 at most 6 in at 20 and 30 ft, sigma 0.10 m. MARViN 7.7 and 8.5 in, FAIL; ADVIO 77.3 and 112.5 in, FAIL. The criterion is nearly out of reach at this sigma: the range's own error has a p90 of 6.5 in, and the correction passes it straight into the along-travel error while leaving the across-travel error untouched.

## A5, IMU excitation and local scale (exploratory, not graded)

ADVIO 5 m windows as in A2. Excitation is the SD of |a| from `iphone/accelerometer.csv` over the window's time span; the scale error is |local scale - 1| against the GPS-rescaled truth. A negative Spearman rank correlation would mean more motion goes with a truer scale. The windows overlap (5 m windows every 1 m), so the independent count is about a fifth of the window count.
